question: What physical information must exist at all, at matched executable bytes, in function space, on real held-out activations?
matched_rule: Each family is configured to the nearest realizable codec near 2.0 fused-active bpw given group sizes that divide both 5120 and 17408. Actual storage_bpw is reported. Comparison is at this operating point, not at each family's unconstrained optimum.

svd_w_r12_bpw0.05.note: storage and fused-active match; materialising dense W_hat is 16 active bpw

prior.starting_point: Naive low-rank at matched bits is dead on dense. This lane searches fitted binary/ternary, residual correction, activation-aware scales, outlier split, and larger groups with the scale cost counted.
prior.g035_axis: column (contraction axis), SVD factors, not binary bases
prior.b4_what_is_being_tested: Shared BINARY bases fitted in function space (AA diag-H) across layers 0 and 31. Not G035 SVD column-basis sharing, not Q80 expert tying.

capture.source_note: Phase-B capture_diverse2: real BF16 parent MLX full-model forward. Not Gaussian. Not Q5_K llama-server. Fit/hold from the capture manifest.

null.name: constant_mean_row_cosine
null.definition: row-cosine of Y_hold against broadcast mean(Y_hold, axis=0)
null.scale_aware_metric: cosine * gain; gain is min(mean-row-ratio, min-col-ratio) folded to [0,1]

accounting.rule: A codec storing a 16-bit scale per group of 64 is 1.25 bpw, not 1 bpw.
accounting.note: Report storage and active, or neither. Scales always counted.

families.name: binary_plus_per_group_scale
families.structure: W_hat = sign(W) * s_g. Signs stored 1 bit/weight. One f16 scale per group of 16 (counted). Activation-aware diag-H scale fitted on X_fit.

function_space_error.metric: rel_fro of Y_hold vs X_hold @ What.T

families.name: ternary_5in8_plus_scale
families.structure: W_hat in {-s,0,+s} per group, threshold s/2, 5 trits in 8 bits + f16 scale per group of 64.

function_space_error.metric: rel_fro of Y_hold vs X_hold @ What.T

accounting_extras.packing_note: storage_bpw uses 5-trit/8-bit packing (realizable kernel). storage_bpw_packed2 is the naive 2-bits/trit bill. storage_bpw_entropy is the log2(3) floor, not a kernel.

families.name: binary_shared_basis_across_layers
families.structure: W_l ≈ sum_{k=1..2} alpha_{l,k} B_k, B_k in {-1,+1} shared across the fitted layers, alpha per group-32 f16. Fitted by AA-weighted greedy then joint LS coefficients. G035 column-SVD sharing is a prior, not this test.

function_space_error.metric: rel_fro of Y_hold vs X_hold @ What.T

accounting_extras.composition_error_space: weight-space ||W-What||/||W|| after shared-basis reconstruction; function-space error is mean_rel_fro

families.name: routed_codebook_pq
families.structure: Each fragment of 4 weights is replaced by one of 256 shared f16 centroids. An 8-bit route selects the fragment. Codebook is shared across rows and subspaces.

function_space_error.metric: rel_fro of Y_hold vs X_hold @ What.T

families.name: generated_walsh_coefficients
families.structure: Signs are generated (popcount(i&j) parity), not stored. Only f16 scales per group of 8 plus the generator identity are physical information. Cache bytes reported separately.

function_space_error.metric: rel_fro of Y_hold vs X_hold @ What.T

accounting_extras.generator_runtime: one popcount(i&j) parity per weight at dequant, or a cached ±1 table
